title: The Part Library window warns while a new number differs from the saved one
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location and at location B under the same part number, so its entry is shared with one other location.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Click at the end of the Part Number.
  5. Type X.
  6. Press Backspace once.
  7. Click at the start of the Part Number.
  8. Type two spaces.
  9. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens with no message under Part Number.

Step 4:

  • The cursor is at the end of the part number.

Step 5:

  • Under Part Number the window shows "This also changes the part number at 1 other location.": location B stocks the same entry.

Step 6:

  • The number reads as saved again and the message goes away.

Step 7:

  • The cursor is at the start of the part number.

Step 8:

  • No message shows: spaces before the number are not a change.

Step 9:

  • The window closes without saving.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R16: “When the user changes the part number and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." for one.”
  • S13-R17: “That message shows only while the typed number differs from the saved one, ignoring spaces before and after it. Parts at other locations count whether they are active or inactive.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part number changed on a part other locations stock | "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
